# #deriv-mismatch-budget-attribution: (1) Prop 1(ii)'s factorization P_pi(C, Omega_{0:t}) = [prod pi] . [environment and channel factors] is the run-wide property that the world is generated by its kernels (each state and observation drawn independently of everything earlier, given the current state, action and law), which GA-1 and (P) alone do not give; it now rests on the fresh-noise and fresh-transition definitions of #def-observation-function and #def-action-transition (A.1 round 6) and should cite them. (2) Its GA-1 line is still the state-only form, conditioning on (Omega, a), while NOTATION's GA-1 and its own Setting condition on S_t = (Omega_t, theta).
